review_description: Ash and his team did a great job. They were flexible with the whole process of dismantling my old system and installing the new to accommodate a roof paint between old and new. Communication was great, we new exactly when they would arrive and and the whole process start to finish was great. Highly recommend Green Coast Solar.
Easy to understand, easy process, great customer service, efficient and no glitches at all.

The whole process from meeting the installer, discussing what I needed and how that could be achieved, through the quotation, installation and subsequent follow up, has been very professional.The installation was performed a lot quicker than I expected and everything was left clean and tidy.  They were happy to explain some of the process and show me what the battery and panels looked like prior to putting everything in place which made me feel confident in what I was getting as a product.I have had a follow up on the installation to check how everything was going which I very much appreciate.Still waiting for the results in using the solar system but am confident in what I have finally picked.

This was an additional install, the guys went about their business politely and effectively the job was finished by lunchtime,  took away all their mess and the system has worked faultlessly ever since.  The enlarged system hooked up with the battery and existing app without too much bother. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend these guys .

Ashley and Hannah were great to deal with answering questions and always available to check our understanding. Nothing was too much trouble!Installation was done in one day including a meter box upgrade! The installation team were very helpful and explained everything to us about how to use our installed system.

Easy quoting process- they come to your home at a time that suits you to personalise your quote. Fast installation. Tidy and punctual. Organised grid connection however at the time of writing this I am still awaiting grid connection 3 weeks post installation so I cannot comment on the products.

I recently installed a 6.6kW system. The process went smoothly from quote to installation.  Ash spent the time going through the quote in great detail and returned again to check the roof and answer a couple of queries. The team arrived punctually to install and were very professional and courteous. I am very happy with the end product.  Highly recommend Green Coast Solar.

We had a 6.6 kw installed recently and we are very pleased with the service provided.The Manager came out to our our premises to advise aaccordingly. His product knowledge was excellant. Most Companies don't do that.The installers were very good workers and courteousI would  thoroughly recommend them

I felt very comfortable dealing with Green Coast Solar and Electrical.I am a big believer in supporting local companies especially a family owned business.Right from the initial phone call to set up a quote to the installation day was a very smooth process.Green Coast Solar came in well below the other quotes using the same products and warranties.I would have no problem recommending Green Coast Solar and Electricial, they are a great team.

I am so happy with the service and advice that Greencoast have delivered. I was really nervous going solar after hearing terrible stories from friends and neighbours.Greencoast tool the time to explain what was suitable for our needs and how we use our home. The crew installing it took great care during the installation, hiding what could be hidden and making sure our kids were safe and out of the way whilst the switchboard was being worked on.My only regret is not finding Greencoast and committing sooner.

Green coast solar were fantastic for the entire process. From quote to the final install , the communication of what was happening and timelines was exceptional. I was kept up to date throughout and also the job was finished on time.

Green Coast Solar and Electrical responded quickly to a request  for a quote on a solar install. Hannah contacted me with the details of who would be coming and when it was suitable for me. Ash came out as arranged and answered any questions I had, checked the meter box and switchboard and advised on a best system for my purposes. The quote was competitive and the install was done very soon after acceptance. The install went smoothly and quickly, with the place left clean and tidy. Could not ask for more, highly recommended.

The whole process beginning to end was simple and quick.The sales rep arrived on time and gave a detailed quote for a quality system.The installers were on time and did the installation quickly and efficiently.The system has been working wonderfully.
All communication was timely, informative, professional and friendly.Installation was prompt and efficient and questions were answered happily and comprehensively.

I found the quote and site visit to be the best of the 6 I received and felt confident and not pressured to continue.The design was also the best and achieved all north facing panels, which non of the other quotes did.I believe that the installation is of a good standard, albeit I am not experienced in solar install. The wiring is neat and tidy, there was no damage to my roof tiles and the panels are neatly fitted.The service was quick, on time and helpful. It all went smoothly.

From the original phone call the customer service was fantastic, like what it use to be prior to customers just been treated like a number.The process from organising a site visit to having the installation completed was just easy , they made the process simple.
Everything was handled very efficiently with no issues regarding installation
Couldn’t ask for a better all round service from the team at Green Coast Solar. Prompt, friendly, tidy and great value for money. Smooth install and results seen immediately.

The guys were organized and on time, friendly while also professional. The work was neat, tidy and completed to a high quality. Nothing was an problem and all my questions were answered. Fantastic company that I would recommend to others!
Great price and detailed quote. Very punctual and delivered what they promised

I was very impressed with the service I received from Green Coast. From the initial quote to the after sales service I have been very happy with the service provided . My power bills have been reduced significantly post installation of the solar system. Would happily recommend this company to friends or family.

Awesome company, No pushy sale techniques, allowed me time to think about my purchase. Didn't bad mouth other companies to make themselves look better.Good honest designs and prices.Would highly recommend
Would highly recommend Ash and his crew. Did a quality job, it looks great.

It was great dealing with Ashley and the team. Helps that he's an electrician made it easy to get a system that will work from quote to install with no surprises. He knew the technology well and it looks like a neat install.Ashley was on time when he visited to quote, updated me regularly with any correspondence. The team arrived on time for install which was only 1 or 2 weeks from the time I went ahead.

Very happy with the recent installation of an updated solar energy system.From quote to installation day all contact was prompt and well-explained. Email correspondence clearly outlined the steps we needed to take. Ashley talked us through a number of options that we could consider for our home.Karen in the office was able to answer any follow-up questions.On the day of installation, Ashley and his team worked efficiently and kept us informed of the work they were doing.Also pleased that our old system was being recycled through a programme that Ashley supports.Thanks, Tracey

I'd recommend Green Coast Solar to anyone who is looking for a solid solar installation. Unlike all those companies who advertise unbelievable cheap solar deals on facebook, Green Coast actually do a site inspection when quating for the job so there will be no nasty surprises and expensive variations on the day. The gear is tier one and my 7.6 kw system was installed in less then 6 hours including the removal of an old system and they also cleaned up cable ends etc... Ashley and his team and real professionals. Customer service was great during the order process and I am yet to need to contact them after the installation.

SALES PROCESS:The quoting process was excellent. Unlike some installers, Ashley (the owner) and Marlin came in person. This gave me confidence as I got to have a face to face conversation with the people who’ll be doing the installation and not some unknown sub-contractors.They came with 2 options, a 6.6kW and a 8kW system. Ashley actually recommend the smaller 6.6kW system after getting to know my usage and requirement. Ashley spotted my switch box needs to be relocated and being an electrician himself he was able to gave me a good price on the spot.Green Coast wasn’t the cheapest quote I got; however, I felt they know their stuff and most importantly Ashley and Marlin were genuine. The price quoted was fair and there was still room for negotiation.INSTALLATION:The installation was top notch. Looked great. Ashley took care of the inverter and installed it in the garage as requested. Marlin was up on the roof with the panels. There was also an apprentice sparky there on the day. Because of the placement of the panels, my antenna had to be moved and Marlin was very happy to cater to my relocation requests and kept me informed all the way. Being a tiled roof, I was expecting ‘some’ tiles to break but I was pleasantly surprised that none were broken after the install.CUSTOMER SERVICE:Karen, who looks after administration, kept me informed throughout and did all the paperwork with the electricity company. Also I had some questions post the install and Ashley was more than happy to take my call and answered my questions.I will do a follow up review in a few months’ time after I get my first bill.
